## What should someone learn or explore?

Describe one concrete process or capacity question. Explain how it differs from the [existing starters](https://github.com/berkebasbay/loopset/blob/main/docs/TEMPLATES.md).

## Model and assumptions

Outline the process steps, demand, timing, queues and shared resources. Use synthetic values and state important simplifications. If it needs behavior outside the current engine, identify that separately.

## Plans to compare

- Original plan:
- First alternative and changed inputs:
- Second alternative and changed inputs:

For an improvement to an existing experiment, describe only the plans affected.

## How could we verify it?

Describe an analytical example, independent reference or invariant that could check the expected behavior. Avoid choosing inputs just to produce an attractive result.

## Optional contribution

If you would like to implement the proposal, note the part you can help with: model, layout, tests, preview or documentation. No implementation is required to suggest an idea.

Use only synthetic data and appropriately licensed assets. See the [template guide](https://github.com/berkebasbay/loopset/blob/main/docs/TEMPLATES.md) for source files, generation and checks.
